items.item_text: 01. I understand that all requested materials have been uploaded as attachments and are required for a complete application. This includes: 1.) Resume; 2.) A cover letter addressing the listed desirable qualifications, personal and professional qualities; 3.) A list of three (3) professional references including name, position, organization, phone number, email, and relationship to the applicant; 4.) Unofficial copies of all college transcripts; 5.) Response to the following question: What does it mean to have a commitment to diversity, and how would you apply this commitment as you conduct your responsibilities in this position? Options: Yes | No
Valid California Class C driver’s license.

Campus Development and Maintenance Administration: Direct the custodial, grounds, and skilled trades’ services to effectively and efficiently implement the goals and objectives of executive leadership. Implement strategic plans and make determinations related to the procedures that govern the areas under supervision. Develop policies and procedures to ensure safe, efficient, and cost-effective operations. Manage vehicle fleet and replacement policy for the district. Manage DMV registration and title needs. Oversee the district’s bus driver regulations and CHP terminal inspections. Develop deferred maintenance programs for district mechanical and electrical systems. Effectively engage and support historically minoritized groups by addressing issues of equity and improving culturally responsive service-oriented practices.

Budget, Purchasing, and Bid Management: Prepare, analyze, and manage the annual department budget for staffing, equipment, and supply needs. Authorize and track expenditures to forecast future needs and provide supportive documentation for proposed expenses. Prepare cost estimates and specifications for construction, repair, maintenance and/or renovation of college buildings and grounds. Evaluate materials, products and services. Recommend and implement facilities related acquisition. Develop bids for facilities related services. Conduct bid walk-throughs, evaluation, recommendations, and pre-construction meetings. Engage in the district’s program review process to assess workload and staffing, administrative support systems, internal reporting relationships, facilities, and technology. Identify and implement approved program improvement objectives to further enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of service delivery methods and procedures.

Compliance and Report Management: Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local laws and regulations pertaining to construction and facilities. Direct the preparation and timely submission of various federal, state, and district reports including but not limited to reports on hazardous substances control and handling, water quality, space inventory, annual emissions, capital outlay plans, physical plant and instructional support plans, and other Facilities Utilization, Space Inventory Options Net (FUSION) required reports. Conduct facility audits related to energy management and environmental safety.

Staff Management: Apportion and assign work amongst subordinate administrators, classified staff, and unclassified staff to ensure that the needs of all areas under responsibility are being met. Approve paid time off for all employees under supervision. Participate in the recruitment process to hire full-time and part-time staff. Analyze employee performance to develop performance evaluations and address performance issues for classified staff and administrators under responsibility. Engage in employee discipline as needed.
Performs other duties as assigned.
